name: Komatsuzaki Rie
source:
Newly transferred to St. Yale Academy, Rie is a girl who is sad and confused after learning the truth about her stepmother's affair with her first love. Broken hearted, she transferred to the prestigious Catholic girls' school to forget herself.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P020]J-List[/url]]
